_comment: Where each module (M1-M7) of the DPI-H policy-maker track meets a step of the journeys (J1-J4.1), and what is technical and what is policy at that meeting point. `asked` cells are the ones where the workshop asks that module's question at that step (workshops/dpi-h-policy-track.workshop.json, steps[].questions); tools/workshop/module-journey-map.ts derives them from there and fails if one has no text here. `draws` cells are where the module reads the step without asking at it (the narrative deck's 'Using the narrative in the exercises' table). Rendered to input/pagecontent/module-journey-map.md.

cells.technical: Hospital immunization record; one DVC per birth dose, signed by Taifafeki's document signer.
cells.policy: The country writes its own use-case statement: which child, which record, which border.

cells.technical: Offline CHW app reads the cards without verifying them.
cells.policy: Where the domestic journey breaks first: a child no national system knows exists.

cells.technical: Client registry holds a child with no birth record; referral to the clinic.
cells.policy: Works / Partly / Breaks for a child born abroad.

cells.technical: Signature checked offline against the cached GDHCN trust list.
cells.policy: What must be true for a nurse to trust a record she did not create.

cells.technical: Product code mapping and the computable national schedule.
cells.policy: Whether a dose given abroad counts at home.

cells.technical: National portal issues a passcode-protected link to the IPS and DVCs.
cells.policy: Whether the family, not the state, starts the sharing.

cells.technical: Point-of-care viewer reads the whole first year from Onesa.
cells.policy: Continuity across a border as the use case's end point.

cells.technical: Facility EMR, product registry, immunization registry, trust services.
cells.policy: Which national block each of these maps to, and whether it exists.

cells.technical: Client registry, CRVS link, offline CHW app, facility registry for the catchment.
cells.policy: Which block issues a child's first identifier; how a birth abroad enters the registries and the coverage denominator.

cells.technical: Clinic EHR as a verifier; trust store loaded from the national trust anchor.
cells.policy: Whether verification sits in each clinic or in one national service.

cells.technical: National FHIR server behind a gateway; IPS assembled from the lifelong record.
cells.policy: Whether a national record exists for the link to point to.

cells.technical: Birth-dose data elements: vaccine, product code, batch, date, giver (immunization DAK core data dictionary).
cells.policy: Who adopts the core data set rather than designing a national form.

cells.technical: A core data element that tells a reported dose from a verified one.
cells.policy: Who defines that element in the national core data set.

cells.technical: Terminology service: Taifafeki's product code kept, Onesa's schedule code added beside it; schedule logic over every dose.
cells.policy: Who owns the national core data set and cross-country code maps; whether vaccine code licensing is settled.

cells.technical: IPS plus an immunization core as the part of the record that crosses borders.
cells.policy: Adopt the IPS and the VHL specification; author only national extensions.

cells.technical: Document signer certificate (DSC) and its key; HCERT/CWT signing of each DVC.
cells.policy: Who signs on behalf of the health sector: hospital, ministry or a national trust service.

cells.technical: Read-unverified: the CHW device decodes but does not verify.
cells.policy: Who is allowed to verify a foreign credential: a phone, a clinic, or only a national service.

cells.technical: GDHCN trust list (DID documents), cached for offline verification; kid lookup.
cells.policy: Who holds the national trust anchor and accepts a foreign signature; what must be decided before onboarding to the GDHCN.

cells.technical: Family wallet on one shared phone, one profile and one VHL per member.
cells.policy: Whether a wallet is a national service, a private app or both, and who approves apps that hold a record.

cells.technical: Viewer verifies the VHL's HCERT against Onesa's DSC from the trust list.
cells.policy: Who verifies abroad, and what a verifier sees.

cells.technical: Credential issued to a child with no national ID.
cells.policy: Legal basis for a facility to issue a health credential to a non-citizen child (decision right: trust anchor; legal basis: consent for dependants).

cells.technical: Temporary id created at a home visit, offline.
cells.policy: Who may create a health identity for a newborn at a home visit, and on whose consent (decision right: architecture).

cells.technical: Parent holds the child's record on a shared device.
cells.policy: Who may hold and share a child's record; the law on dependants.

cells.technical: Consent resource recorded; 4-digit passcode; 14-day expiry.
cells.policy: Legal basis for opening a home record abroad on consent; procurement clause for IG conformance; who sets link protection.

cells.technical: AuditEvent logged in Onesa on every access, including failed passcodes.
cells.policy: The agreement that every view abroad leaves an entry at home, and who reads it (legal basis: cross-border).

cells.technical: One trust network for every programme that signs credentials.
cells.policy: Build once for the region, not for immunization alone.

cells.technical: Code map between neighbours' vaccine products.
cells.policy: Whether neighbours build one mapping together instead of each building it.

cells.technical: Regional IPS + immunization profile with national extensions.
cells.policy: Profile once for the region, keep national extensions sovereign.

cells.technical: Connectathon test of issuer, gateway and viewer.
cells.policy: What the country sends to a regional connectathon within twelve months.

cells.technical: Issuing to the WHO certificate specification.
cells.policy: Candidate first move where issuance is missing.

cells.technical: GDHCN onboarding and a clinic verifier.
cells.policy: Candidate first move where verification is missing; recurrent cost of key management.

cells.technical: Whichever moment breaks hardest for the country.
cells.policy: A twelve-month first move with a named owner, and the cost driver that dominates it.

technical.label: Client registry and identifiers
technical.text: The same registry that gives Somsak a temporary id at home (J2b) is the one his IPS is assembled against (J4.0b). M2 asks whether it exists; M5 asks who may write to it.

technical.label: Signing and the trust list
technical.text: One PKI carries three moments: Taifafeki signs the DVCs (J1), Onesa verifies them offline (J3a), and Onesa's own key signs the VHL a Taifafeki viewer checks (J4.1). Built once, for every credential.

technical.label: Core data set and terminology
technical.text: The reported/verified element (J2a), the product code map (J3b) and the cross-border IPS profile (J4.0b) are one core data set, read at three points.

technical.label: Lifelong record and the share link
technical.text: The national record, the wallet and the gateway's audit log are one service seen from the family, the clinician and the ministry.

policy.label: Trust anchor (decision right)
policy.text: Who signs at home and who accepts a foreign signature is one decision; M4 names the holder, M5 asks under what mandate.

policy.label: Consent for dependants (legal basis)
policy.text: The child acts through his parents from birth to the clinic abroad; the same rule decides who registers him, who holds his record and who may share it.

policy.label: Cross-border legal basis
policy.text: Opening a home record abroad and logging the view at home need one agreement, which is cheaper to reach regionally than pair by pair.

policy.label: Core data set custody (decision right)
policy.text: Whoever owns the core data set owns the code maps to neighbours; the room decides whether that is a country, a region or WHO.
